learningGoals: Identify Verbs as Action Words or Doing Words (क्रिया वे शब्द हैं जिनसे किसी काम के होने का पता चलता है). ⚡
Recognize verbs in daily activities (e.g., sleeping, eating, running). 🍽️
Match verbs to appropriate nouns (e.g., Birds fly, Fish swim). 🦅
Act out different verbs to understand their meaning physically. 🎭
Use simple action words to construct basic sentences. ✍️
conversationStarters: What are three action words (काम) you did today since you woke up? 🌅
A frog jumps! Can you tell me what action a bird does? 🐦
What is your favorite 'doing word' when you go to the playground? 🛝
teachingTips: Explain the grammar rule in Hindi: 'जो शब्द बताते हैं कि कोई व्यक्ति या जानवर क्या काम कर रहा है, उन्हें Verb या क्रिया कहते हैं।' 🧠
Play 'Simon Says' but call it 'Action Words' to make them physically do the verbs (Jump, Sit, Clap). 🤸
While cooking or cleaning, narrate your actions: 'I am washing (verb) the dishes.' Ask them to name the verb. 🍽️
Write 'doing words' with a different colored pencil when doing homework to make them stand out. 🖍️
Ask your child to watch their favorite cartoon for 2 minutes and shout out all the action words they see. 📺

funActivities.title: Action Word Charades 🎭
funActivities.description: Write verbs like 'cry', 'laugh', 'dance', 'eat' on chits. Take turns picking a chit and acting it out without speaking, while the other guesses the verb.

funActivities.title: Verb Freeze Dance 🧊
funActivities.description: Play music and tell your child an action to do while the music plays (e.g., 'Hop!'). When the music stops, they must freeze. Change the action word every round.

funActivities.title: Animal Actions Matching 🐾
funActivities.description: Draw or write names of animals on one side of a page (Dog, Bird, Frog) and verbs on the other (Bark, Fly, Jump). Have your child draw a line to match them.
